name: pixel-text-fill
title: Pixel Text Fill
description: Scroll-scrubbed pixel text fill with an ordered-dither color edge.

props.name: pixelSize
props.description: Pixel cell size used by the dither edge.

props.name: stagger
props.description: Character stagger window for the fill head.

props.name: bandFraction
props.description: Soft pixel band width as a fraction of each glyph.

props.name: settleBlend
props.description: How early the final text color blends in behind the pixel edge.

props.name: maxWidth
props.description: Text wrapper width as a percentage of the section.
